rows.note: Use 地下 as the all-purpose Hong Kong Cantonese term for the floor of a building at ground level.

example.english: We'll wait for you on the ground floor; you don't need to go upstairs.

rows.note: Use 起步階段 when “ground floor” refers metaphorically to the initial stage of a project rather than to a physical floor.

example.english: We joined the project at the ground floor stage and watched it develop step by step.
